app.title: Classroom Escape
ui.splash_hint: Turn the sound on and tap Enter if you dare.
ui.room_closed: The teacher left and the room was closed.
ui.difficulty_hint: Used for rooms you open and for solo. Easy: a lighter room. Hard: a darker room with more flickering.
ui.seat_hint: First come, first served: once you pick, the seat is yours. Desks with a lock are too close to the door. If you don't pick, you get a random one.
ui.seat_front: Front of the class (board and door)
ui.lobby_hint_teacher: Share this code with your students.
ui.lobby_hint_student: Waiting for the teacher to start the round.
ui.facing_board: You are facing the board. You can't see the students. Press Space to turn around.
ui.teacher_hint_catch: Click a moving student to catch them. Press Space to turn to the board.
ui.teacher_stats: In class: {retained} of {total}. Escaped: {escaped}. You need at least {needed} to win.
ui.teacher_won: You kept the class! You win.
ui.teacher_lost: Too many students escaped. The students win.
ui.howto_student_title: How to play: you are a student
ui.howto_student_1: Tap a glowing desk to jump to it. Jumps go in a straight line: green = 1 desk away, {near}s to answer; orange = 2 desks away, only {far}s.
ui.howto_student_2: Answer the question before time runs out. Right: you move, then you must rest on the new desk for a few seconds. Wrong: you are stuck on your own desk for a few seconds. Too slow: you freeze, longer, and get a scare.
ui.howto_student_3: Watch the teacher! While he is LOOKING (red warning), anyone who is moving gets caught and sent to the back of the class, as far from the door as possible.
ui.howto_student_4: Only one person per desk, so you can't jump onto an occupied desk. Skip over it by jumping 2.
ui.howto_student_5: Reach a desk right next to the door (front of the class, by the board) and jump onto the door to escape. You cannot jump over a desk to reach it.
ui.howto_teacher_title: How to play: you are the teacher
ui.howto_teacher_1: Turn to the board and the students will start moving behind your back.
ui.howto_teacher_2: Turn around (button or Space), then click a student who is moving (red ring) to catch them. They are sent to the back of the class.
ui.howto_teacher_3: You win if at least half the class is still in the room when time runs out. A student who reaches the door escapes.
ui.facing_back: Looking at the back of the class
ui.cue_looking: THE TEACHER IS LOOKING! Stay still.
ui.pick_desk: Tap a glowing desk to jump to it.
ui.no_free_chair: No free desk within reach. Wait for one to open up.
ui.feedback_wrong: Wrong answer! You are stuck on your desk for a few seconds.
ui.feedback_caught: THE TEACHER CAUGHT YOU! You are sent to the back of the class.
ui.ghost_hint: You escaped! You are a ghost now. Help your classmates.
ui.ended_teacher_won: The teacher kept the class. Round over.
ui.ended_students_won: The students got away! Round over.
ui.setup_hint: Write up to {max} questions with 3 options each. The desks share them in turns.
ui.select_question: Select a question number to write it.
error.room_not_found: Room not found. Check the code.
error.server_busy: The server is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_state: You can't do that right now.
error.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do that.
error.invalid_input: Please check the nickname and the code.
error.no_students: Wait for at least one student to join.
error.questions_incomplete: Write at least one complete question (text and 3 different options).
error.student_locked: You are locked for a moment.
error.desk_occupied: Someone is already on that desk, or heading to it. Try the next one.
error.out_of_reach: That desk is too far (jumps go 1 or 2 desks in a straight line).
error.seat_forbidden: That seat is too close to the door.
